description: Runs every model in a folder (and its subfolders) through a draft and saves the results into the output folder, mirroring the subfolders. A model that fails does not stop the others. Returns the counts and one row per model; long runs report progress.

draft.description: A built-in draft id from list_drafts (for example "reduce"), or the path of a .draft.json saved from the app or of a saved graph (.json).

format.description: Result file format. Default: the draft's (GLB for the built-in drafts).

out.description: The folder the results go into (made if missing).

overwrite.description: Replace results that already exist. Default false: the call is refused instead.

report.description: Also write the full report here (.json or .csv).

name: process_folder
title: Process a folder
